text: {"hypotheses":[{"statement":"Applying the recently proposed periodic context‑consolidation technique (see arXiv item 17d25ddc) to the model used in the ICLR submission will reduce interference caused by naïve append‑style training, directly addressing Reviewer 2’s criticism and yielding measurable performance improvement over the current rewrite vs append ablation baseline.","confidence":0.73,"support_ids":["7ed212c7","17d25ddc"],"tags":["ablation","memory","consolidation"]},{"statement":"The newly approved 2400 GPU‑hour H100 allocation (eed14d58) can be partitioned to run the large‑scale ablation sweep required for the ICLR rebuttal while simultaneously generating the extensive agent‑memory benchmark datasets needed for the co‑author workshop paper (5b4ba95b), thereby meeting both deadlines more efficiently.","confidence":0.66,"support_ids":["eed14d58","7ed212c7","5b4ba95b"],"tags":["gpu","benchmark","workshop"]}]}
